chapter: Trio years, the Sands and Armstrong recollections
title: The Frolic, the organo and Neal Tate; the Metropole
summary: First use of the organo at the Frolic and avoiding the Metropole's trap.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x:
What about the Sands?
You were working--you had the organo; where did
the organo come in? Is that the first time you
used the organo?

At the Frolic. That's
the first time I used the organo.
Yeah. It seems to me that's the first I heard of it.
This same guy, this Neal Tate, is the same guy that was working for you then?
At first I had another little guy and then Neal Tate came in.
He was really great. '55 is the Frolic, and I stayed at the Frolic for five years.
I know, I was there all the time. I was there a lot.
There sure used to be some fine things in there.

The guy at the Metropole, they tried to pull a fast one. We were pulling a lot of people away from the Metropole at one time and they offered me a job at the Metropole to come in there in the afternoon. I knew what they were going to do, I would have come out of there and they would have fired me after a month.
That's exactly what they would have done. I know that guy, that was Harriman, he was a real bastard.
